title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Substitutions
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: An IFB allows for a 'Brand Name or Equal' product. A vendor submits a bid with a much cheaper substitute brand but fails to include the requested technical literature proving the substitute meets the salient characteristics. The buyer should:
options: Conduct their own internet research to see if it is equal
Deem the bid non-responsive because equivalency cannot be verified at the time of bid opening
Award the bid, then test the product upon delivery
Assume it is equal since the vendor signed the bid form
questions.explain: When offering an 'equal' product, the burden of proof rests entirely on the bidder to provide descriptive literature with their bid. Failure to do so renders the bid non-responsive as the agency cannot evaluate the offer.
